headline: Puig Campana blows the taper ceiling — now rest hard
narrative: Most of the week played the taper straight: a club-run double on Monday, weights on Tuesday with a new set of rehab exercises, a café run and an errand jog on Thursday, a couple of rides and a swim around the edges. Then Saturday rewrote it — Puig Campana with Dave, the biggest on-foot day since the peak block, out on the race's home terrain less than a fortnight from the start. That one outing carried the week well past a target that was meant to be a ceiling.

Call it honestly: this was the 'legs springy, short and snappy' week, and a long mountain day isn't that — the surplus is real and it lands close to the race. The consolations are genuine, though: time on the race's own mountains, and the descent-specific right quad came down a serious descent without a murmur — no flags, nothing on the adductor, calf or ankle either. So bank it, and pay for it properly. Next week is race-week-minus: easy plus mobility, lots of sleep, and a tiny ceiling honoured this time — then it's race week, GTCB on the Friday night.
